full_judgment: 2. The petitioner, an Accountant in the Finance Division, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bangladesh, while on transfer to the Accounts Cell, Ministry of Planning and Planning Commission at Shere-e-Bangla Nagar, was proceeded against in a departmental proceeding under the Government Servants (Discipline & Appeal) Rules 1976 consequent to which he was dismissed from serve by an order dated 2.10.84. His appeal there from having been dismissed, he filed Tribunal Case No. 143 of 1985 before the Administrative Tribunal. By judgment and order dated 7.3.91 the Administrative Tribunal dismissed the case.
